Recovery & Movement with Sports Massage Highland.
Sports and Remedial Massage Therapist for over 15 years
The channel focus, is to support you in maintaining exercise through each stage of pregnancy and assisting your recovery postnatally. 
Sharing helpful, evidence based workout videos for all fitness levels as well as educational videos to help in avoiding injury and aiding in injury rehab at any stage in life.
Included are some short self helps videos for various aches and pains suitable for anyone looking for extra support.
The advice in these videos is general and not individual recommendation. If you follow my workouts please ensure you work within your limits and seek personalised professional advise as required.
